notes.title: Several Minor Tweaks and Quality of Life updates!
notes.notes:
Moved global volume down on all tracks.
Decreased the global encounter rate for enemy encounters.
Changed 2 character specific chests so they must be recruited prior to opening them.
Added text to Crystal Shield Armor and bumped effect from 10 to 15 percent.
Lowered stats of Baby Dino and Munchy Dino.
Increased Rainbow Rod's elemental defense percents.
Improved a couple Axe weapon stats particlarly the Magic Attack Stat.
Updated Quest Description for Magma Sigil to provide a better clue.
Reduced Maximum Level Cap of Enemies in Gamma Tower.
Increase Passive MP restore on Airia's Upgraded Flute from 3% to 4%.
Added a message when the Desert Shrine Prize Activates.
Upgraded Inspired skill to provide between 1 - 3 random buffs.
Upgraded Cadderly's Shell skill to be a double buff.
Updated the Ribbon accessory so anyone can wear it.
Updated Description on Genji Gloves, removed the ATK penalty as well.
Updated Description on Ninja Mask gear.
Updated Quest Description for "The Hidden Nexus" for Gamepad controls.
Moved a Chest in the Sky Shrine out from behind the pillar.
Changed the text of the NPC before the Frourio Caverns.

notes.title: Minor Patch Update
notes.notes:
Fix Minerva's Autocrossbow not applying Status Effects Properly.
Fixed misc spelling typos.

notes.title: Updated the directory where the save folder lives.
notes.notes:
Updated the directory where the save folder lives. 
It's now located in your windows env.APPDATA\Roaming\An Unusual Cadence\

Caution that it's advised to first copy your entire save folder in the "www" folder off somewhere safe before running this update or launching the software.

notes.title: Testing some new Achievements I'm looking to add.
notes.notes: Will enable and remove the "Hidden" tag once I can confirm they are properly working with Steam.

notes.title: "Map" Key Item updated.
notes.notes: Resized / positioned World Map when viewing the "Map" Key Item as well as added several location names to the map.

notes.notes: Removed the .exe Extension. Forgot Steam does that automatically.

notes.notes: Had a bad .exe name. Renamed and pushed update.

notes.title: 3 Bugs Addressed
notes.notes:
1. Skipping the Ruins battle no longer blocks your exit from the forest.
2. Talking to Leech repeated does not proc Missing Image error.
3. The Basher weapon no longer renders Immortal status.

notes.title: Addresses "Rhajat" Bug.
notes.notes:
Thanks to player Euphoniac for finding this rare bug!
Updated some code to suppress the Character Sprite (Is shouldn't have been there anyways) when talking to the kid near the Vending Machine. Was a rare instance that could only occur if certain people were spoken to in a certain order.  That's it for this update!  

Eric
